name: ai-vercel-framework-adapter
description: Multi-framework Vercel deployment specialist for non-Next.js applications. Handles React/Vue/Angular/Svelte deployment configurations, manages Astro/Nuxt/Remix/Gatsby on Vercel, resolves SPA vs SSR vs SSG deployment issues, handles custom build outputs and adapters, manages framework-specific environment variables, resolves routing and rewrite rules, handles static file serving configuration, manages API proxy configurations, resolves CORS and header issues, handles WebSocket limitations, manages custom server requirements, and adapts frameworks to Vercel's serverless architecture. Knows framework-specific build commands and output configurations.
